fields.System.Title: Allow Mobile Redemption Offer Receipt Retrieval from Vconnect through API (Proxy)
fields.System.Description:
As Venetian VConnect,
I need to retrieve the receipt associated with a successfully completed mobile offer redemption through a Connector proxy API,
so that Venetian Mobile can present the correct receipt without directly integrating with Trilogy.

Description

Venetian performs offer list, offer detail, and offer redemption through VConnect. After VConnect confirms that a mobile redemption succeeded, VConnect calls an authenticated Connector proxy endpoint to retrieve the corresponding receipt from Trilogy.

The request contains the property, player, offer/redemption transaction, receipt-template or receipt reference, and correlation information required by the agreed Trilogy contract.

Connector forwards the request through the approved property integration path, receives the Trilogy receipt response, and returns the agreed result to VConnect.

When a receipt is generated:

  • If email or SMS delivery is not part of the receipt’s configured delivery channels, the generated receipt must enter the existing player-receipt ingestion path.
  • If email or SMS delivery is requested, the existing distribute-receipt workflow owns contact handling, notification delivery, and receipt ingestion.
  • The same receipt must not be ingested twice when the proxy and distribution paths are involved.

This endpoint retrieves the receipt after redemption. It does not perform the initial offer redemption.
fields.Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria:
AC1 — Accept an authorized VConnect request

  • Connector exposes an authenticated proxy endpoint for approved VConnect integrations.
  • The request identifies the correct property, player, offer, successful redemption transaction, and required receipt reference.
  • Requests are restricted to enabled tenants and service endpoints.
  • An unauthorized application or disabled tenant cannot call the endpoint.

AC2 — Require a successful redemption

  • Receipt retrieval is initiated only for a redemption that VConnect reports as successfully completed.
  • A failed or incomplete redemption does not generate or return a receipt.
  • A missing or invalid redemption transaction reference is rejected.
  • The proxy does not execute the original offer redemption a second time.

AC3 — Correlate the correct receipt

  • Connector forwards the identifiers required for Trilogy to locate or generate the receipt for the successful redemption.
  • The returned receipt belongs to the requested property, player, offer, and redemption transaction.
  • A receipt from another player, property, or redemption is never returned.
  • Each returned individual receipt has a stable Receipt ID.

AC4 — Proxy the request through the approved integration path

  • Connector sends the request through the approved Trilogy/property communication path.
  • VConnect does not require direct connectivity to Trilogy.
  • Request and response correlation identifiers are preserved across VConnect, Connector, and Trilogy.
  • Connector does not alter receipt content returned under the agreed contract.

AC5 — Return a usable receipt result

  • A successful response provides the Receipt ID and the agreed receipt or retrieval information needed by VConnect.
  • The result identifies the associated redemption transaction.
  • Any Receipt URL, status, expiration, or display metadata returned is consistent with the record stored in Loyalty Cloud.
  • VConnect can use the returned reference to obtain the matching receipt without searching through unrelated player receipts.

AC6 — Ingest receipts without email or SMS delivery

  • When the receipt has no email or SMS delivery channel, the generated receipt is submitted through the existing player-receipt ingestion contract.
  • The ingested record contains the complete generated HTML and required metadata defined by User Story 1445168.
  • The receipt becomes available to the applicable storage and mobile-retrieval workflows.
  • Ingestion failure is not incorrectly reported as successful completion of the complete receipt workflow.

AC7 — Avoid duplicate ingestion

  • When email or SMS delivery is requested, the existing distribute-receipt workflow owns receipt ingestion.
  • The proxy does not independently create a second stored record for the same receipt.
  • Retries use the same redemption transaction and Receipt ID.
  • A retry does not cause a second redemption, receipt, or Receipt URL.

AC8 — Handle one or more legitimate receipts safely

  • Each legitimate receipt returned for the redemption has its own Receipt ID.
  • Multiple legitimate receipts are not incorrectly combined.
  • Repeated copies of the same receipt are not returned or stored as separate receipts.
  • The initial Venetian workflow may return one receipt, while the contract must not prevent the existing platform model from representing multiple legitimate receipts.

AC9 — Handle downstream failures

  • Trilogy timeout, unavailability, validation failure, and not-found conditions are mapped to the approved Connector API error format.
  • Connector does not return a successful receipt response when Trilogy did not produce or locate the receipt.
  • Errors include safe correlation information for troubleshooting.
  • Errors do not expose another player’s receipt data or internal implementation details.

AC10 — Protect sensitive data

  • Property and player authorization is validated before receipt information is returned.
  • Receipt HTML, contact information, and player information are not unnecessarily written to logs.
  • The response contains only the information approved for VConnect.
  • Cross-property or cross-player access is rejected.

Dependencies and boundaries

  • Depends on: VConnect successfully completing the original offer redemption and supplying the required correlation/reference data.
  • Uses: Existing Trilogy Redeem Offer Receipt capability.
  • Uses: 1445168 and 1365562 when the generated receipt must be ingested and stored.
  • May feed: 1470260 and 1445171 after storage.
  • Distinct from 1459617: This is the VConnect proxy retrieval flow; 1459617 is the BeOn post-redemption availability signal/callback.
  • Out of scope: Offer list, offer detail, original redemption, mobile UI, receipt-list presentation, receipt HTML rendering, and direct notification delivery.
